evidence.title: Still haven't filed your taxes? Here's what you need to know

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS instructions for electronic tax payments and filing extensions
occurrences.quote_span: The IRS will automatically process an extension of time to file
occurrences.speaker: Internal Revenue Service
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS credit/debit card tax payment fee schedule
occurrences.quote_span: You can also pay by credit or debit card, but you will be charged a processing fee .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS filing-extension and tax-payment rules for 2022 returns
occurrences.quote_span: Note, however, that an extension to file is not an extension to pay.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS combat-zone tax deadline rules and military service dates
occurrences.quote_span: But your specific extended filing and payment deadlines will depend on the day you leave (or left) the combat zone.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS instructions for electronic tax payments and filing extensions

occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS 2022 late-payment interest and penalty rates
occurrences.quote_span: You will be charged interest (currently running at 7%) and a penalty on any amount you still owe for 2022 but haven’t paid by April 18.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS 2022 federal income-tax reporting rules for listed income sources
occurrences.quote_span: Other potentially taxable and reportable income sources include: Interest on your savings Investment income (e.g., dividends and capital gains) Pay for part-time or seasonal work, or a side hustle Unemployment income Social Security benefits or distribution from a retirement account Tips Gambling winnings Income from a rental property you own
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS rules for deductible IRA contributions and taxpayer IRA account records
occurrences.quote_span: That will reduce your tax bill and augment your retirement savings.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS Free File eligibility criteria for 2022 returns
occurrences.quote_span: You also are likely eligible to use IRS Free File (intended for those with adjusted gross income of $73,000 or less) so it won’t cost you to submit a return.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS Form 1099-K reporting requirements for tax year 2022
occurrences.quote_span: The 1099-K is required if you made more than $20,000 in over 200 transactions during the year. (Next year the reporting threshold drops to $600 .)
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS filing-season statistics for 2022 tax returns
occurrences.quote_span: So far this tax season, the IRS has received more than 100 million income tax returns for 2022.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS Form 1099-K reporting threshold applicable to the following tax year
occurrences.quote_span: Next year the reporting threshold drops to $600 .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS combat-zone tax filing extension rules and military taxpayer records
occurrences.quote_span: If you’re in the armed forces and are currently or were recently stationed in a combat zone, the filing and payment deadlines for your 2022 taxes are most likely extended by 180 days.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: Illinois CPA Society tax guidance and IRS reporting rules for vacation-rental income
occurrences.quote_span: “Be aware that there’s no form for some taxable income, like proceeds from renting out your vacation property, meaning you’re responsible for reporting it on your own,” according to the Illinois CPA Society.
occurrences.speaker: Illinois CPA Society
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS 2022 individual income tax filing deadline guidance
occurrences.quote_span: If yours is among them, here are some last-minute tax-filing tips to keep in mind as the Tuesday, April 18 deadline approaches.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS return-processing and refund-delay guidance
occurrences.quote_span: Little mistakes and oversights delay the processing of your return (and the issuance of your refund if you’re owed one).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS Form 1099-R reporting and issuance rules for tax year 2022
occurrences.quote_span: 1099-Rs for distributions over $10 that you received for a pension, annuity, retirement account, profit-sharing plan or insurance contract
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS 2022 income-reporting rules for third-party platform payments
occurrences.quote_span: But even if you didn’t get a 1099-K you still must report all the income that you made over third-party platforms in 2022.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS 2022 filing requirement and standard deduction thresholds
occurrences.quote_span: Lastly, if you made little to no money last year (typically less than $12,950 for single filers and $25,900 for married couples), you may not be required to file a return.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS electronic payment and automatic extension instructions
occurrences.quote_span: If you do that, the IRS notes you will not have to file a Form 4868.
occurrences.speaker: Internal Revenue Service
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS disaster-tax-relief notices and filing/payment extension records
occurrences.quote_span: If you live in a federally declared disaster area, have a business there — or have relevant tax documents stored by businesses in that area — it’s likely the IRS has already extended the filing and payment deadlines for you.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS Interactive Tax Assistant service documentation
occurrences.quote_span: The IRS provides an “ interactive tax assistant ” that can help you answer more than 50 basic questions pertaining to your individual circumstance on income, deductions, credits and other technical questions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS California disaster-relief announcement and federal filer statistics
occurrences.quote_span: Thanks to many rounds of extreme weather in recent months, for instance, tax filers in most of California — which accounts for 10% to 15% of all federal filers — have already been granted an extension until Oct. 16 to file and to pay, according to an IRS spokesperson.
occurrences.speaker: IRS spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS 2022 IRA contribution limits and tax-filing deadline rules
occurrences.quote_span: One very last-minute way to reduce your 2022 tax bill: If you’re eligible to make a tax-deductible contribution to an IRA and haven’t done so for last year, you have until April 18 to contribute up to $6,000 ($7,000 if you’re 50 or older).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS automatic filing-extension rules and Form 4868 records
occurrences.quote_span: You will be granted an automatic six-month extension to file.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS 2022 IRA contribution limits and tax-filing deadline rules
occurrences.quote_span: One very last-minute way to reduce your 2022 tax bill: If you’re eligible to make a tax-deductible contribution to an IRA and haven’t done so for last year, you have until April 18 to contribute up to $6,000 ($7,000 if you’re 50 or older).
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing

occurrences.checkable_against: IRS electronic payment options and fees for 2022 tax payments
occurrences.quote_span: If you opt to electronically pay directly from your bank account, which is free, select “extension” and then “tax year 2022” when given the option.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Internal Revenue Service 2022 individual income tax filing
